We'll publish once we have a sufficient amount of wishlists.So wishlist now and tell your friends!Thank you for your attention to this matter.

events.title: What is Vug?
events.summary: Vug: From Caves to Stars is a game that combines cave flyers - a popular genre from 90s Finland - with a galaxy campaign where factions expand, wage wars and eventually meet the endgame.Time ticks forward when player jumps between star systems. During those jumps, the factions expand, start wars, skirmish and claim systems from each other.When you enter a new star system, you can explore and mine various planets, moons and asteroid belts.
